## Where you are, for Pulse

Pulse using where the user is, once they turn it on: what they said they'd
do at a saved place comes up as they get there or leave, a pick from the
daily look ahead can wait for a place or a kind of shop the phone watches
(walking past), and Pulse's look-ups can start from where they are. Like the
rest of Pulse, it's on main and in App Store builds.

**Siblings:** Settings > Pulse's Where you are and Walking past switches and their captions · What Pulse
remembers (the place a promise waits for, and the saved place it names) ·
location sharing (Settings > Location: sharing in the background, its pause,
saved and private places, When Hermes read your location) · the notifier's
location store and its arrivals and departures, in each profile that reads
the location · the place rules (call limits and jobs by place read the same
arrivals) · Pulse's follow-ups, the daily look ahead and the Pulse screen (a
held pick's card and its Why?) · Pulse's look-ups (`conduit_location`, and
Maps from "me" or a saved place) · Pulse pushes (a reminder for a place, or a
pick at its moment, goes time-sensitive; see Notifications) · the Watch
(those pushes there) · walking past (the shops the phone watches with a
second CLMonitor, Apple Maps search on the phone, the sealed reply to a
location batch, `spot_entries` in the next one) · the `hermes conduit-push
pulse where`, `pulse spots` and `pulse status` commands (`pulse status` shows Where you are; walking past's state and entries are in `pulse spots`) · the privacy policy
(notifier docs/privacy: what Pulse keeps of walking past and how to turn it off)

**Code**
- App: `Conduit/Services/PulseSettings.swift` (PulseState's whereYouAre, whereReady and walkingPast, PulseMemoryPlace), `Conduit/Views/PulseSettingsViews.swift` (the switch, its caption and the line when Pulse can't read the location yet, the Walking past switch, its caption and the lines when this iPhone isn't watching shops (Location settings, or saved places using every place iOS lets Conduit watch), which update as Location settings change, either switch or Pulse's own off, turned off here or found off in Pulse's answer when the page loads (never in the state the page kept from last time), stopping this iPhone's watches at once through LocationSharingController.forgetSpots, and all three on sending at once so the reply brings the shops to watch; a reply to a batch sent before the off is ignored and a batch still connecting then carries no shop entries, shops becoming allowed again in iOS Settings sends at once, and a change made elsewhere otherwise reaches this iPhone with the host's next reply, and a promise's place in What Pulse remembers), `Conduit/Services/PulseFeed.swift` (pulseReadsWhere, and "where you are" in what a card's turn looked at), `Conduit/Location/PulseSpotWatcher.swift` (walking past: the shops searched and watched, first state, entries), `Shared/Location/LocationSpots.swift` (watches, entries, the sealed reply, PulseSpotState), `Conduit/Location/LocationSharingController.swift` (watchesSpots, spotEntered, sendNow's spot_entries and spots_room), `Conduit/Location/LocationSyncEngine.swift` (spotsReplied), `Shared/Location/LocationBatch.swift` and `Shared/Location/LocationSharedStore.swift` (spot entries in the batch and unsent, spots.json)
- Saved places' arrivals and departures on the iPhone: `Conduit/Location/LocationBackgroundMonitor.swift` (the saved places' CLMonitor, released when its events end so the next sync opens it again by name)
- Location settings the Walking past lines follow: `Conduit/Views/LocationSettingsViews.swift` (background sharing at Precise, Always and Precise Location for Conduit, and saved places, whose count can leave iOS no room to watch shops)
- Notifier: `notifier/pulse_places.py` (the switch and whether the phone shares in the background, moments, place words to saved places, what waits for a place, what Pulse remembers about a place, the look ahead's picks held for a place with `bring_up`, `settle_picks` and `release_picks`, and what `pulse where` says), `notifier/pulse_followup.py` (`waits_for_place`, `place_reached`), `notifier/pulse_ahead.py` (a pick's `moment`), `notifier/pulse_memory.py` (the place words), `notifier/pulse_store.py` (moments, `place_words` and `place_on`, and the cards at level `moment`), `notifier/pulse_tools.py` (location reads behind the switch), `notifier/dashboard/api/phone_data.py` (`_location_ingest` hands arrivals and departures to Pulse), `notifier/pulse_control.py` (`where`, `where_ready`, a memory item's `place`), `notifier/cli.py` (`pulse where`, `pulse spots`), `notifier/pulse_spots.py` (walking past: watches by intent and circle, the reply, entries made moments with their reach, lateness), `notifier/location_store.py` (`spot_entries`, `spots_aad` and the sealed `reply`, only at Precise), `notifier/docs/privacy/index.html` (what Pulse keeps of walking past)
- Tests: `notifier/tests/test_pulse_places.py` (the switch, moments, places in what memory keeps, a reminder that waits for its place, and what a place brings up), `notifier/tests/test_pulse_held.py` (the look ahead's picks held for a place), `notifier/tests/test_pulse_spots.py` (walking past); the app's `ConduitTests/PulseSettingsTests.swift` (Where you are, Walking past's state, and a promise's place in What Pulse remembers), `ConduitTests/LocationSharingTests.swift` (Walking past turned off drops the shop entries waiting to be sent) and `ConduitTests/LocationSpotsTests.swift` (walking past: the shared vector, the batch, the watcher)

**Rulings**
- Where you are is off until the user turns it on, in Settings > Pulse or with `hermes conduit-push pulse where on`, and separate from sharing location with Hermes. Pulse reads where the user is only while it's on and Conduit shares the location in the background, not paused; Settings > Pulse says when it can't read it yet. A private place is never read. Off reads nothing and deletes the arrivals and departures and the shops come near that Pulse kept, and so do turning Pulse off and wiping location (turning walking past off deletes the shops alone); the places on what Pulse remembers stay, like the rest of its memory. The app shows the switch, a promise's place and "where you are" in Why?'s look-ups to a plugin that reports `pulse_where` (2026-10-27, Eric's card on step 5: Opt in; notifier #420, #1379; the shops, 2026-10-28, Eric in the Pulse thread, as for walking past below).
- A commitment or promise said for a place ("next time I'm at Costco", "when I leave work") keeps the place's words, only when they're on the item's own line, never guessed. They name a saved place by its name or its kind ("home", "work" or "the office", "the gym", "school"), and a kind's words name only a place of that kind; words that name no saved place match one saved later. The item waits for its place, 30 days or a week past its date, instead of checks on a schedule. Getting there (or leaving, when that's what was said) makes it due: checked as any follow-up, with where the user is and what Pulse remembers about the place, its reminder goes at once and time-sensitive, and Why? says so. Nothing is made due at night, on a quiet day, in a part of the day closed for follow-ups, during an event or a Focus that holds calls (driving doesn't count), or with follow-ups off or kept for the brief: it waits for the next time (2026-10-27, notifier #420, #422).
- Arrivals and departures at saved, non-private places, at most 15 minutes old, reach Pulse from `/location/ingest`, here and in each profile that reads this location, and Pulse handles them first on its next tick; each is kept a day. One with nothing waiting for it says nothing yet: what it would have brought up is kept for `pulse where` to list, to judge before it speaks (2026-10-27, notifier #420, #422).
- The daily look ahead may hold a pick that would push for a saved place it listed, until the start of the pick's day and at most two weeks, ten at once. The held card waits off the Pulse screen, read every six hours like a card held for the brief. The first time the user gets to (or leaves) the place where Pulse may speak up, a turn of its own brings it up, one pick a moment, looking things up first but never the web, and pushes as "Pulse noticed something", time-sensitive. A turn that doesn't go out leaves it waiting. At its window's end, with Where you are off, or once its kind is made quieter than a push, it comes on the screen without a notification; done while it waited, it goes where it was made, as seen (2026-10-27, notifier #423, #424).
- Walking past: the look ahead may hold a pick for a kind of shop (`"moment": {"spot": "a florist"}`), held as a saved place's pick is, in the same window and the same ten at once, and an item said for a place that matches no saved place is watched by its words. Only search words go to the phone, in the sealed reply to a location batch that carries `spot_entries`, at most six; it searches Apple Maps near where it is, watches the nearest three per search word, taken in turn, with a second CLMonitor in what saved places leave of iOS's twenty (at most ten in all), searches again after moving 1 km (at most every 30 minutes) or starting or stopping driving, and reports the shop's name, when, and a fresh fix's distance, accuracy and speed, never the shop's coordinates. Only with Pulse, Where you are and walking past on (on by default; the Walking past switch in Settings > Pulse, shown under Where you are while it's on and only when GET /pulse reports `spots` (notifier 0.111.0, so an older plugin shows no switch), `pulse spots off` or PUT /pulse's `spots` turns it off alone and forgets its entries; its caption says what the phone searches and what the gateway learns), and while background sharing is at Precise, with Always and precise location, not paused; nothing inside a private place. The phone's Apple Maps search is its own, not one of Pulse's look-ups: it doesn't count against their caps, and the host learns only what the phone reports of an entry. Each watch has an intent sizing its circle, aimed at a useful chance to act rather than the shop's edge: an opportunity (a pick's default) 750 m walking and 3 km driving, any entry counts; an errand (an item's default) 100 m, the fix inside it; an arrival 100 m, the fix inside with its accuracy; the look ahead may set its own `radius_m`, within its intent's bounds (an opportunity's 500 m to 5 km, an errand's and an arrival's 50 to 300 m). The phone's search has no daily cap: it runs on the phone, costs the host nothing, and only moving 1 km or starting or stopping driving sets it off, at most every 30 minutes. Pulse says the user came near the shop or got to it or right by it, never that they went in. Every entry is kept 30 days with how late iOS told the app (`pulse spots`), and it ships live, no shadow mode (2026-10-28, Eric in the Pulse thread; notifier #435, #1414).
- Both CLMonitors on the iPhone (saved places and walking past's shops) stay open while they watch, one each by name, and when one's events end, by an error or a plain finish, it is released and the next sync (foreground, an authorization change, a place or shop list changed) opens it again by name, keeping what it watched; until then that monitor's arrivals wait (2026-11-03, #1683, from #1680).
- With Where you are on, Pulse's look-ups may read `conduit_location` and ask Maps from "me" or a saved place, within the look-ups' caps, each read listed in Settings > Location's When Hermes read your location under the Pulse chat (2026-10-27, notifier #420).

**Open gaps**
- A failed Maps search in a walking-past pass (no network, Maps refusing) still counts as that watch's search, whether every search failed or only that watch's: the watch has no shops until the next 1 km move after 30 minutes, and a reply with the same list retries only when no watch has any shops. Retrying sooner would change the 30-minute ruling, which is the maintainer's call (found in review on #1517).
- None of it has been tried on a phone against notifier 0.104.0, nor the Walking past switch and its caption against notifier 0.111.0, nor arrivals from a real day's location sharing (#1379, #1426, notifier #420, #422, #423, #424).
- A held pick also matches another saved place with the same name: the model names the place by its name, and the name keeps a pick working after its place is saved again (notifier #424).
- Walking past hasn't been tried on a phone: how late iOS fires for 100 m circles, and whether a 3 km driving circle helps or nags, are what the kept timings are for (notifier #435, #1414). Arriving at or leaving a place that is neither saved nor a watched shop still wakes nothing.
- An item said for a place that has no saved place keeps waiting for one until it expires; meanwhile, with walking past on, its words are watched as a kind of shop and coming near one makes it due as getting there would. What Pulse remembers says it waits, but nothing asks the user to save the place.

**Checked:** 2026-11-05, #1793 (the place editor built from Settings' cards, see Sheets in Settings' look); 2026-11-03, #1683 (the saved places' monitor reopens when its events end, as walking past's did; the saved-place monitor added to Code); 2026-10-31, #1555 (Settings > Pulse opens on its kept state, which never stops this iPhone's watches: only Pulse's answer does; the stores needed no change); 2026-10-30, #1542 (All history stays after the host's 2000 limit and stops at the oldest reading; the stores needed no change); 2026-10-29, #1517 (the `pulse` branch merged into main: the app paths it lists are on main now; nothing else changed); 2026-10-28, #1462 (the notifier code it lists moved from dashboard/plugin_api.py to dashboard/api/, one module per feature, notifier #449); 2026-10-28, at #1427, carrying #1426 from the `pulse` branch (the Walking past switch and its caption in Settings > Pulse, closing that gap, with the plugin version that shows it and the Location settings its lines follow; the shops' deletion cites the walking-past decision); at #1423, carrying the `pulse` branch's entry: #1414 (walking past, from notifier #435 and the app's spot watcher; the rest as at #1379).

## Artifacts

The files, pages and links Hermes made, listed for every chat (the Chats
bar's Artifacts page) or for one chat (its … menu), opened in the chat's own
viewers, with Show in Chat. A Markdown file opens in the Markdown reader the
Folder draws it with, formatted, with Show Source and a system Open In and
Share handoff; every other file keeps Quick Look, a page its full-screen
view, and a link Safari. Beside the list, the Folder tab (Workspace files).

**Siblings:** the Artifacts page (from the Sessions bar and Bots Home's shortcut) · a bot's Bot Overview (its whole profile, #1678; see Bots Home) · a chat's own Artifacts sheet · the panel
beside the chat on a wide window · Bot Chats
(kept in the bot's own profile) · All (every included profile's chats) ·
group rooms (no Artifacts list) · a Bot Chat's Work panel (done: it shares the column beside
the chat, one at a time; see Bot workstreams) · the Folder's Markdown reader (Workspace files) ·
the chat's `MEDIA:` file cards (see Files Hermes attaches) · the notifier's artifacts route · README.md

**Code**
- List model and merge: `Conduit/Services/Artifacts.swift` (ArtifactItem, ArtifactSource, ArtifactFeed, ArtifactsClient, its keptRoute, keptPage and answer(_:withoutRowsOf:))
- Which stores a list reads (a bot's overview: `ArtifactScope.bot`), a chat's ids, Show in Chat: `Conduit/Services/AppState+Artifacts.swift` (artifactSources, activeChatArtifactSessionIDs, botChatIDs, showArtifactInChat)
- Screens: `Conduit/Views/V2/V2ArtifactsViews.swift`; a Markdown artifact's sheet: `Conduit/Views/Components/MarkdownDocumentSheet.swift` (MarkdownArtifact, MarkdownDocument), also opened by a chat's file card (`Conduit/Views/Components/MarkdownText.swift`, GatewayMediaFileCard); the system Open In handoff: `Conduit/Views/Components/MediaPreviewPresenter.swift` (presentOpenIn); the column beside the chat and its toggle: `Conduit/Views/V2/V2ConversationScreen.swift` (openArtifacts, showsSidePanel)
- A chat's store: `Conduit/Services/AppState.swift` (botStoreProfile, openLinkedBotChat, openOtherProfileChat; removeSavedCopies takes a deleted chat's rows from the profile's kept list)
- Host: `notifier/artifacts_index.py`, `notifier/dashboard/api/workspace.py` (GET /artifacts, one profile per request)
- Tests: `ConduitTests/GatewayRestartTests+Artifacts.swift`, `ConduitTests/MarkdownDocumentSheetTests.swift`, `ConduitTests/AppStateMultiDashboardTests.swift` (testADeleteAnsweredAfterASwitchSaysNothingOnTheNewDashboard)

**Rulings**
- A list reads each store the chats it covers are kept in: a Bot Chat's sheet reads the bot's profile, and the Artifacts page reads the profile in use, each other profile All shows while it's on, and every other bot's Bot Chat, merged newest first (2026-10-24, #1203, Eric's report).
- Stores are read one at a time (the host reads two lists at once at most) and each shows as it arrives; a refresh keeps the list it is refreshing until every store answers. A bot's chat or other profile that can't be read leaves the rest listed.
- A bot whose profile is read whole (the profile in use, or one All shows) isn't read again for its Bot Chat; that chat's rows still go by the bot's name and open the way Bots opens them.
- The profile in use is always read, even when All leaves it out.
- A Bot Chat has no row in the workspace's chat list, so its ⋯ menu finds its ids from the chat itself (with the durable id Hermes confirmed under the bot's profile, so a relaunch or a reopened runtime still finds it) and the roster's registry id and lineage tip (2026-10-24, #1218, Eric's report: the item was greyed out).
- A picture image generation made is listed: the host reads `image_generate`'s result, a saved file as a written image and a hosted one as an image link (2026-10-24, #1218 with notifier #353, plugin 0.71.1, Eric's report: a bot's generated pictures were missing).
- A Bot Chat is listed though Hermes keeps it hidden: the host reads a chat asked for by id whether hidden or not, and a profile's whole list takes its hidden "Bot Chat" session and the sessions continuing it, while other hidden chats (a group room member's turns) stay out (2026-10-25, #1272 with notifier #376, plugin 0.78.1, Eric's report: a bot's pictures were still missing from both lists).
- On a window with room for the chat and the panel, ⋯ › Artifacts opens beside the chat instead of in a sheet, with its own search field; a phone keeps the sheet (2026-10-27, #1399).
- Artifacts and a Bot Chat's Work panel share the column beside the chat: opening one closes the other, and the Artifacts toggle is lit only while Artifacts show (2026-11-01, #1619; the Work panel's side column is design C.6, part of M2 as Eric approved it).
- The panel beside the chat drags wider or narrower by the line beside it, kept per device; it shows at its standard width's window as before (Eric, 2026-10-29, #1492, see Resizable columns on a split window).
- One host path is one artifact across stores: profiles share the host's files, so a file two stores list shows once, at its newest mention.
- A file still opening is dropped when the list moves to another server or profile, and only the latest open clears the spinner. Every reload, including one on a dashboard without artifacts, outdates the request before it (2026-10-24, from #895's review, #1191).
- A Markdown artifact opens in the Markdown reader, not Quick Look: the same `MarkdownText` the Folder draws a `.md` with, read-only, with Show Source and a system Open In/Share handoff to another reader (MDReader on the user's iPad). A file that isn't UTF-8 or is over 16 MB falls back to Quick Look. The file's own pictures page through its own pictures, not the chat's it was opened over, and a chat's `MEDIA:` file card for a Markdown file opens the same reader. A Markdown file the user sent is drawn as their message is: its `MEDIA:` lines stay text and fetch nothing from the host (2026-11-06, PeterChencha's #1879, carried in #1884).
- A list opens on what it listed last time, kept as it opens (every kind, unsearched, its first page) for each store's profile, a chat's own for the chats read last, which a deleted chat takes with it, as it takes its rows from the profile's; a bot's store that fails shows its kept rows, which don't page on, and kept rows wait for the plugin to say it serves artifacts or rule them out. The update notice shows only once it rules them out: with nothing kept, the list shows its loader until then, or offline, that Conduit isn't connected. Connected with no word from the plugin (its read failed as Conduit connected), the list asks it again as it opens and on a refresh, and with nothing kept says it couldn't reach the dashboard's notifier, with Try Again, if it still doesn't answer. A list kept or loaded empty says so at once, offline too (2026-10-31, #1582 and #1584, issue #1533; see Screens that open on their last answer).

**Open gaps**
- Group rooms' messages aren't listed: a room has no Artifacts list, and its members' replies stay out of the Artifacts page.

**Checked:** 2026-11-06, #1884 (carries #1879, and closes its file-card gap: a `MEDIA:` card for a Markdown file opens the same reader; the reader's pictures page through the file's own); 2026-11-06, #1879 (a Markdown artifact opens in the Markdown reader, with Show Source and the Open In/Share handoff; Windows and Mac names, the 16 MB ceiling and the Quick Look fallback; code, tests and map); 2026-11-03, #1703 (the `bot-workstreams` qualifiers go now that Bot Mode is on main); 2026-11-03, #1701 (`bot-workstreams` merged into main for TestFlight, as its PRs left this entry); 2026-11-03, #1679 (on `bot-workstreams`, a chat opened from Artifacts pushed in Bots stays in Bots, under the page; from Sessions unchanged); 2026-11-03, #1678 (on `bot-workstreams`, Bots Home's Artifacts shortcut opens the page, and a bot's overview lists its whole profile's, Show in Chat closing the overview first); 2026-11-01, #1619 (Artifacts and the Work panel share the column beside the chat); 2026-10-31, #1584 (from #1582's review, a deleted chat's rows leave the profile's kept list, and offline a list kept empty says so); 2026-10-31, #1582 (a list opens on what it listed last time, and a deleted chat takes its own; the update notice waits for the plugin to rule artifacts out, kept rows or none, and a list whose plugin never answered asks it again); 2026-10-29, #1491 (a picture opens in the picture viewer and pages through the list's pictures); 2026-10-29, #1492 (the panel's width drags); 2026-10-28, #1462 (the notifier code it lists moved from dashboard/plugin_api.py to dashboard/api/, one module per feature, notifier #449); 2026-10-27, #1399 (the panel and the Folder tab); #1272 with notifier #376; the sheet's ids at #1218; the page and Show in Chat at #1203; opens and reloads at #1191.

## Workspace files

The Folder beside Artifacts: the open chat's working folder or a project's,
browsed as a tree, searched, previewed, edited and changed, and a file path a
reply names opened there (#1389).

**Siblings:** a chat's ⋯ › Artifacts sheet (Folder tab) · the panel beside
the chat on a wide window · the Chats bar's Artifacts page (projects' folders
only) · + › Workspace in the drawer shell (V2 off, which has no Artifacts) ·
file paths in replies (Links in messages) · group rooms (a tapped path opens
the Folder on its own) · Bot Chats (the bot's profile) · the notifier's
workspace routes · the project folder picker (same Hermes listing) · Files
prepared for preview (how the Folder opens pages and Quick Look) ·
README.md

**Code**
- Client and path links: `Conduit/Services/WorkspaceFiles.swift` (WorkspaceFilesClient and its kept listing and recent files, resolve, WorkspacePathLinks, WorkspaceRoot, WorkspaceReveal)
- Roots, profile, reveal and refresh: `Conduit/Services/AppState+Workspace.swift` (workspaceRoots, workspaceProfile, absoluteWorkspacePath, revealWorkspaceFile, showWorkspaceLookup, clearWorkspaceLookupNotice, noteWorkspaceToolCompleted, readWorkspaceText, workspaceDirectoryEntries, parentWorkspacePath for the project folder picker's Enclosing Folder); `Conduit/Services/AppState.swift` (makeProjectFolder, the project folder picker's New Folder through the same plugin route); `Conduit/Services/AppState+PendingSend.swift` (dismissComposerNotice, which shows again a notice the lookup's covered)
- Tree, search, viewing and changes: `Conduit/Services/WorkspaceExplorer.swift` (askPluginIfUnanswered, from open and refresh)
- Screens: `Conduit/Views/V2/V2WorkspaceViews.swift` (WorkspaceFolderView, its Add menu on the shared V2AddGlyph in `Conduit/Theme.swift`, WorkspaceFileSheet, WorkspaceMoveSheet), `Conduit/Views/V2/V2ArtifactsViews.swift` (ChatArtifactsContent, the page's tabs), `Conduit/Views/V2/V2ConversationScreen.swift` (ChatSidePanel, openArtifacts), `Conduit/Views/ChatSupportSheets.swift` (WorkspaceSheet), `Conduit/Views/RootView.swift`, `Conduit/Views/Components/ComposerBar.swift` (+ › Workspace)
- Links: `Conduit/Views/Components/SelectableTextView.swift` (bridge), `Conduit/Services/ConduitAppLink.swift` (file)
- State: `Conduit/Models/Models.swift` (WorkspaceEntry, WorkspaceFilePreview), `Conduit/Services/AppState.swift` (workspaceReveal, workspaceRevealGeneration, workspaceLookupNotice, workspaceNoticeUnder, workspaceChanges, showWorkspaceSheet, openWorkspace)
- Tests: `ConduitTests/WorkspaceFilesTests.swift` (testWorkspaceListingAndRecentFilesAreKeptForNextTime, testAReplysFileNameIsResolvedForTheChat, testAFileLookupOpensTheFileOrSaysItIsntOnTheServer), `notifier/tests/test_artifacts.py` (resolve_name and /workspace/resolve), `ConduitTests/AppStateMultiDashboardTests.swift` (workspace listing and file pick, testAFolderOpensOnItsListingKeptLastTime, testATappedFileNameAsksThePluginAndALaterTapWins)
- Host: `notifier/workspace_files.py` (notifier #431), `notifier/dashboard/api/workspace.py` (/workspace/list, search, recent and the POST actions; capability workspace-files; /workspace/resolve, capability workspace-resolve), `notifier/artifacts_index.py` (resolve_name)

**Rulings**
- The Folder lives in Artifacts, not behind the composer's +: a tab in the chat's ⋯ › Artifacts sheet, beside the chat on a wide window, and on the Chats bar's Artifacts page. + › Workspace stays only in the drawer shell, which has no Artifacts (2026-10-27, #1399, Eric: "+" hurt visibility).
- The full explorer: previews, search, Recently Changed, new folder and file, rename, move, duplicate, delete with a confirmation, upload, and text editing that refuses a save over a file changed since it was opened (Replace It or Keep Editing) (2026-10-27, #1399, Eric picked it).
- The tree starts at the chat's folder and switches to a project's folder, never above them (the New Project folder picker is not the Folder: it goes up to choose a project's folder, see New project); the plugin keeps every path inside the root it's given and leaves out files holding keys or passwords. Hermes' own file routes already reach the home folder, so this scopes the view rather than guarding the host: on a personal install the plugin takes any folder as a root, and on a hosted or locked install only one inside Hermes' files folder (2026-10-27, #1399).
- Without the plugin's workspace routes the Folder still browses and opens files through Hermes' own listing; search, Recently Changed and changes ask for a plugin update.
- A path in a reply is a link when inline code names one, when plain text names a path with a folder and a known file type, or when a Markdown link's destination is a file on the host (see Links in messages, issue 1809); a relative path is in the chat's folder. A bare name or a relative path (a Swift file named on its own, say) is looked up for the chat by the plugin when tapped: the chat's folder, then the newest full path ending in it that the chat's own tool calls, tool output and replies carry (a quoted path read whole, spaces and brackets included; never a hidden room the chat was branched from), as long as it is a file on the host the Folder would show (never a secret file); a later tap wins over a lookup still running; with none, a notice above the composer says the file isn't on the server (deleted, or on another computer), until a later tap answers or the chat changes (a notice it covered, such as a message that came back, shows again then) instead of opening a missing file. A plugin without the lookup, a failed lookup or a group room keeps the chat's folder (2026-11-05, #1819 with notifier #557, issue 1809: on Eric's host, 407 of 677 file mentions in two weeks were bare names, Desktop chats had no folder recorded, and the chat's tool calls placed 228 of them). It opens in the Folder, at the file, switching to the chat's or a project's folder that holds it. A file in none of them opens to read only, outside the tree, as Hermes' own file routes would show it (2026-10-27, #1399).
- An empty file uploads as an empty file: the app sends it as is and the plugin writes it (2026-11-03, notifier 0.127.2, issue #1708; before, the plugin refused it as missing data).
- A tool that writes, moves or deletes files, or runs commands, refreshes an open Folder when it completes; nothing polls.
- An answer for another dashboard, profile or folder is dropped, its failure too, and only the latest file picked shows.
- A folder opens on the listing and Recently Changed the plugin gave last time, kept on the phone for the folders read last, while it asks again; a folder opened in the tree, Hermes' own listing, search and a file read Hermes. Only an answer the folder can read is kept. A kept listing waits for the plugin's word rather than giving way to Hermes' own listing: the plugin reporting its routes reads the open folders again through them, and saying it doesn't serve them reads them through Hermes'; the update label waits until then. Connected with no word from the plugin (its read failed as Conduit connected), the folder asks it again as it opens and on a refresh, as the Artifacts list does (2026-10-31, #1582 and #1584, issue #1533; see Screens that open on their last answer).

**Open gaps**
- Group rooms have no Artifacts: a path tapped in a room opens the Folder on its own, at the projects' folders.

**Checked:** 2026-11-05, #1820 (follow-ups from #1819's reviews: quoted paths with spaces or brackets and names ending in punctuation are found, notifier #558, 0.132.1; a tap's lookup tested end to end; README); 2026-11-05, #1819 (a tapped bare name or relative path is looked up for the chat, notifier #557, issue 1809; group rooms keep the projects' folders; README); 2026-11-05, #1814 (a reply's Markdown link to a file opens here too, issue 1809; README); 2026-11-05, #1793 (Move built from Settings' cards, see Sheets in Settings' look); 2026-11-05, #1787 (a folder's Add uses the shared glass +, see The + that makes something new); 2026-11-03, #1711 (an empty file uploads from the Folder, notifier #527, 0.127.2, issue #1708); 2026-11-03, #1701 (`bot-workstreams` merged into main for TestFlight, as its PRs left this entry); 2026-11-03, #1685 (the New Project folder picker reads the same listing, goes above the chat's folder and makes a folder through the plugin's route; the tree is unchanged); 2026-11-01, #1619 (opening the Folder beside the chat closes a Bot Chat's Work panel, which shares the column; see Artifacts); 2026-10-31, #1584 (from #1582's review, the folder asks a plugin that never answered again as it opens and on a refresh); 2026-10-31, #1582 (a folder opens on its kept listing and recent files, which wait for the plugin's word, and keeps only an answer it can read); 2026-10-29, #1491 (a picture, opened or Share or Save, opens in the picture viewer among its folder's pictures); 2026-10-29, #1492 (ChatSidePanel's width drags; the Folder in it is unchanged); 2026-10-28, #1462 (the notifier code it lists moved from dashboard/plugin_api.py to dashboard/api/, one module per feature, notifier #449); 2026-10-28, #1407 with notifier #431 and its follow-up; 2026-10-27, #1399 with notifier #431.

open Conduit, pick a bot and talk to it; direct sessions are the Sessions tab
(designs/bot-mode-coordinator/bots-home-ui.md, layout A).

**Rulings**
- A bot's color, for its ring, glow and comet, here and in the overview, is its chat's glow color: the one picked for its profile or drawn from its photo, else its Hermes color, else its name's hue (build 248: rings took the name's hue whenever Hermes kept no color, and didn't match the bot).
- Layout A (Eric, 2026-11-03, from three layouts): a three-across portrait grid in each bot's color with a soft glow, no card per bot and no hero bot; Pulse and Artifacts as named pills under the title; Group Chats under the bots. Rejected before it: an asymmetric hero card, and a two-column grid of rectangular cards (2026-11-02).
- Bots Home is a scroll view, not a List: a List takes a touch and hold and a drag for its whole row, and the grid is one row, so every long press lifted the whole grid under the top-left bot's menu and no portrait could be dragged (Eric, 2026-11-03, #1714). The Bots list without Bots Home (the drawer shell) stays a List, its rows' swipes with it.
- Group Chats on Bots Home are small portraits, four across on a phone: each room's icon in a ring with its name under it, hosted rooms, then Hermes Desktop's (a small computer on the icon; a tap shows its messages), then the room being started (Eric, 2026-11-05, option B of the Group Chats canvas, over a sideways shelf, rows in a Settings card and a Rooms shortcut: the rows looked out of place under the portraits). The Bots list without Bots Home keeps its rows.
- A room's tile has a menu and a drag, as a bot's portrait does (Eric, 2026-11-06: group chats had neither). Its touch and hold has what the open room's menu has that the host serves: Group Settings (it opens the room, whose screen shows them once Hermes has read them, within 15 s), Choose, Generate and Remove Group Picture and Image Playground, then Reorder Group Chats, then Disband Group after a confirmation; Stop needs the room's driver read, so it stays in the open room. No Rename or Pin, as the open room's menu has neither (Hermes keeps no pin for a room, and Conduit has no Rename for one though a host may serve `groups.rename`), and the order does a pin's job. A tile dragged onto another takes its place, as an app does on the Home Screen: carried on it goes after that tile, carried back before it, so two rooms swap (Eric, 2026-11-06, TestFlight: a drop onto the right-hand neighbour did nothing, as it went before it); past the last one it goes to the end. Held over a tile 0.3 s (the bots' wait, a quarter second before #1883), it takes its place while still in hand and the others slide aside, as on the Home Screen (Eric, 2026-11-06, #1871: "have it act like the iOS home screen"), and the drag is a move, so it shows no + as if the room were being added to something (the tile counts as in hand for 3 s after a drop target last saw it, as a bot does, since the system can let go of the drag's item early and a + came back now and then: Eric, 2026-11-06, #1883). A room's drop and a bot's are told apart by the tile or portrait in hand (and, failing that, by the mark their text carries), so no bot takes a room and a dragged bot never moves one. A bot's drag is a move the same way (Eric, 2026-11-06: a lifted bot showed a + and neither moved nor merged on TestFlight), through one drop handler for the portraits, the grid's end and the room being started. The rooms keep the person's order by room id, matched exactly, like the bots' (a room it doesn't name yet goes first, as Hermes lists them, so a room just made still lands where Hermes lists it, as the #1830 ruling has), saved on the phone and synced as `groups.order`, and every list of rooms follows it. Hermes Desktop's groups, read-only, keep neither and stay after the hosted rooms.
- No line under the bots; New Group Chat is the + on the Group Chats heading, as New Bot is the title bar's, not a row under the rooms (Eric, 2026-11-03, #1714).
- Pinned bots come first, each group in the person's order, as Hermes Desktop lists them, and a pinned portrait has a small pin on it; a pinned bot dragged among the others stays with the pinned ones (Eric 2026-11-04, #1742: Pin did nothing once he had set an order).
- Bots keep the person's order: a bot never moves for being busy. Until it's set they follow Hermes' roster (pinned, then recent activity). A portrait is dragged in place (dropped on a portrait it takes its place, after it when carried on and before it when carried back, so neighbours swap, Eric 2026-11-06, #1871; held still (within 12 pt) for 0.3 s over another, off its face and the 14 pt ring around it (#1886) or anywhere when the two can't make a room, it takes that place while still in hand and the others slide aside, as apps do on the Home Screen, with no bar, Eric 2026-11-06, #1871; carried on, the wait starts again, so a bot on its way to a face never slides it away, Eric 2026-11-06, TestFlight: the faces moved before the room's hold finished, #1883; past the last one to the end), or moved in Reorder Bots from the menu, the way with VoiceOver, like pinned chats (Eric asked, 2026-11-03). Hermes keeps no order, so it's kept on the phone by profile name and goes to other devices through Sync across devices (`bots.order`); a bot made since goes at the end, and a hidden or deleted one keeps its place for when it's back. Every other list of bots follows the same order, except Bots Home's voice menu, which puts the bot that talked last first, as a list of who to call (#1714).
- A bot held still over another's face, or within 14 pt beside it (above it, only the few points to the cell's top edge, since the grid's edge drop takes the rest) (Eric, 2026-11-06, TestFlight after #1883: holding over a face never started a room, since a bot slowing down on its way in took the face's place first; it was the face's middle, its outer tenth left out), for half a second merges instead of moving (Eric, 2026-11-06, #1871: carried across faces to reorder, it kept swelling them; now a move of more than 12 pt starts the half second again, and in the gaps between cells or on its name it only moves) (the drop ends the hover before it lands, so a face that was swollen up to a second before still merges: Eric 2026-11-04, #1742, a drop always moved): the target swells with a +, and the drop starts a new room of the two; a bot over its own place, a hidden bot, or a host that can't start rooms never swells, and that drop only moves. Nothing goes to Hermes yet: a bar at the bottom lists the members (tap a face to take it out), more bots are dropped on any member or tapped in the grid (a hidden bot's tap still opens its chat; a bot hidden or deleted meanwhile leaves the room), under the bar's faces, Cancel and Create, a full-width name field (beside them six faces left a phone no room) whose prompt is the bots' names (left empty, that is the room's name), and Create makes the room from the bar, with no sheet (Eric, 2026-11-06, #1863: New Group Chat after dragging made drag and drop extra steps; this replaced the confirm step of 2026-11-03). Purpose, notes and who answers are set in Group Settings once it's made. While Hermes makes it, the bar's controls wait, Create spins and no bot joins or leaves by a tap, drop or the menu; a failure says why in red under the name (over the grid if rooms stopped being possible meanwhile, and the room goes; one left Bots meanwhile still finds the bar with it, kept for a retry with the same id), keeps the bots and the name, and a retry with the same ones sends the same room id, so the gateway never makes a twin. The room being started shows last among the rooms, its members' faces overlapping in a dashed gold ring, under the typed name (else "New room"); a tap on it goes to the name field, and a bot dropped on it joins (it swells only for a bot that can: not a hidden one, one already in, or one past the limit). Each bot that joins, by a drop, a tap or the menu, flies there: a copy of its face leaves its portrait, which stays put, shrinks as it goes and settles into its place in the icon with a small bounce, about half a second (Eric, 2026-11-05: the room should grow out of the drop, not pop in); with Reduce Motion the face is just there. Once Hermes makes the room, it takes the new room's place and slides to where Hermes lists it; a create that fails leaves the room being started as it was, and Cancel shrinks it away. Cancel, leaving Bots, or losing what rooms need clears it. A room holds up to 6 bots, and a merge that would overflow it never swells; the menu's Start a Room with… begins the same bar from one bot, or adds it to the room being started. Create counts only the bots still shown. The Group Chats heading's + and a bot's Groups menu still open New Group Chat, where nothing was picked by dragging.
- The portrait and the name open the Bot Chat; the ⓘ beside the name always opens the overview, and so does the status pill under it when it says something, since a tap on "Needs you" means "show me" (Eric, 2026-11-06, #1850, from his mockup, over an Overview pill on every bot: a row of Overview buttons read as clutter). The status says what needs the user first ("1 needs you", with a mark on the portrait), then what's working ("2 working"), else nothing, the still ring saying it (Eric, 2026-11-06: no Idle word), its height kept so a row doesn't jump when a bot starts work, and never names the policy, a setting in Edit Bot. The ⓘ has a 44-point square target, overlapping the name's by 7 points, and a Mac tooltip; at accessibility text sizes it moves to the status line so the name keeps the cell's width. VoiceOver stops on the portrait (its status as the value, Overview as an action) and the ⓘ; the name and the pill are hidden from it, each repeating one of those. It reads each bot's work once as Bots Home shows or connects, and doesn't poll: the Bot Chat and the overview do.
- The overview is reusable, never a screen between picking a bot and talking to it. Its Work is the Work panel's list, not a second one; its Artifacts read the bot's whole profile, labelled as another profile's unless it's the one in use. Without the plugin's workstreams it shows Chat and Artifacts only. From the Bot Chat, Chat just closes it.
- Pulse and Artifacts are global: the shortcuts open the same pages as the Sessions bar, pushed in Bots, Pulse full screen as it is there.
- A failed read of the Group Chats (whether Hermes hosts rooms) or of the bots asks again on its own, 2, 4, 8 and 16 s later, so its notice clears once Hermes answers, also when the app never saw the connection drop; an answer starts the delays again (Eric 2026-11-04, #1735: "The connection to Hermes dropped" stayed over Group Chats after he reconnected).
- The gestures are found by one tip and an empty state, never by motion on the portraits or a line that stays (Eric, 2026-11-06, #1850): a TipKit tip under the bots, shown once Bots Home has two or more, says touch and hold for the menu (a right-click on a Mac), drag to move and hold over another bot to start a room; it goes for good when it's closed, a bot is dragged, Reorder Bots opens or a room is begun. Group Chats with no rooms yet, where rooms can start and there are two bots, says "Hold one bot over another to start a room." in place of its empty grid, gone with the first room. The UI tests and App Store screenshots run without either (BotsHomeGesturesTip.hiddenForTesting).
- The app opens on Bots. Finish setting up and Repair Connection show at Bots Home's top too, so a first launch or a failed connection offers them where the app opens.
- Only a bot's own chats (its Bot Chat or a workstream's chat) and a room tapped on Bots Home open inside Bots, whatever chat was open before (a Bot Chat from Bots, and the room, is marked as coming, see Opening a Bot Chat; before, a room opened over anything but a Bot Chat jumped to Sessions); any other session opened while Bots shows (a notification, a widget, a Shortcut) goes to Sessions. A chat opened from a page pushed in Bots (Pulse, Artifacts) stays in Bots, under that page.
- The status reads nothing and shows nothing on a plugin that serves no workstreams, unless the bot talks in a room.
- A portrait shows its bot's state by how it moves (Eric asked for more life, 2026-11-03, from the canvas's Portrait states board): idle is still, its ring at half strength with no glow; working, a comet of the bot's color circles the ring once every 6 s; needs you, no circling, the ring orange and breathing once every 2.6 s, its badge nudging when it first shows or more comes to need the user; finished (its ready count goes up), one green ripple and a check on the badge for 1.6 s, then still. Hand-offs between bots (Eric, 2026-11-03, the canvas's Bots working together board), read from the bot's work list, whose asks name the other bot: answering another bot's ask, the pill says "Helping Hermes" and the comet carries the asking bot's color ahead of its own; with an unanswered ask of its own and nothing else going on, "Waiting on Furina", its ring in slow creeping dashes and that bot's face on the badge. The status's order is needs you, helping, working, in a room, waiting on, then nothing. A portrait on Bots Home moves only while Bots Home shows: not on another tab, nor under a screen pushed over it or a sheet of its own (an overview, Reorder Bots, a new room or bot, Edit Bot, a Desktop group chat, Repair Connection; split, a chat beside the grid leaves it showing), and a finish that lands meanwhile plays when it shows again. The Bot Overview's header portrait moves the same way while its own sheet shows, wherever that sheet opened, Bots Home or a Bot Chat's title. Nothing moves with the app in the background, or with Reduce Motion or Low Power Mode (followed as it changes): then working is a bright ring, needs you the orange ring and badge, finished the check alone.
- Group rooms show as live rooms, never round the portraits, since a bot can be in several (Eric, 2026-11-03, the canvas's Bots working together board): a hosted room whose bots are talking now (its driver working, Hermes' `groups.state`) has a gold ring and "Talking now" with a breathing dot under its name, in its own place among the rooms, so it never moves for being busy (Eric, 2026-11-05, option B: this replaced the row of chips over the grid). A bot talking in one says "In Trip planning" on its pill, in several "In 2 rooms", also without the plugin's workstreams. The Bot Overview's header says it too, under the bot's name. Bots Home asks the 8 rooms talked in last every 12 s while it shows (under its own sheets too, so the pills stay right), and so does the Bot Overview while it shows, wherever it opened; the two share each round's read, so the rooms are asked once a round; not otherwise. A talking room that doesn't answer stays talking for two more reads, then drops out, and a room's misses count only while it's among the rooms read.
- A Bot Chat opened from its portrait grows out of it, a circle opening into the chat (iOS 18's zoom), and Back or a swipe down shrinks it back in (the design canvas's Transition board, 2026-11-03). So does one opened from its overview on Bots Home, by Chat or by opening one of its workstreams there, which counts as a tap on its portrait (Eric 2026-11-04, #1742: both slid in and out). Only the chat of the portrait just tapped, pushed on Bots Home itself: a Bot Chat a notification, widget, Shortcut, call or link opens, one opened under Pulse or Artifacts, beside the list on a split window, on iOS 17 or with Reduce Motion is the usual push. "Just tapped" is within 3 s of the tap: an open slower than that (a slow link) pushes without the zoom rather than zooming a chat that arrives later from somewhere else. The shell pushes the chat as the list closes, before the open lands (#1700), so a tap's push zooms whichever chat is still named open until its own lands, and stops zooming if that open fails (build 248: the zoom only worked when the open landed first). Back keeps the zoom armed through its pop and lets it go once the chat has left, so the chat shrinks back into its portrait (build 248: Back let go first and popped plainly). The zoom's source is a copy drawn behind the portrait, not the portrait itself: iOS hides a source while the zoom runs, and on a phone the portraits stayed hidden after, empty rings (build 248). A workstream opened from the Bot Chat shows in the same pushed screen and counts as its bot's, so the zoom holds through it and Back from the Bot Chat still shrinks it home (Eric, 2026-11-03, #1714: the zoom changed on the pushed screen, and Back then had no animation). The zoom's own swipe back starts only where the transcript has no text, so a Bot Chat grown from its portrait also goes home by a swipe toward the trailing edge from anywhere, as a session's chat does (Eric, 2026-11-03, #1714). A room tapped among the Group Chats grows out of its portrait and shrinks back into it the same way, by the same rules and the same swipes (Eric, 2026-11-06, #1864: group chats should open and close as Bot Chats do); its screen goes back only to Bots Home, so the zoom's own swipes stay on there, and a room shown over a workstream's chat has its Back and goes back by it, never to the workstream's Bot Chat. A swipe back started and let go (the zoom's swipe down, pinch or edge pan, or the stack's edge swipe) leaves the chat with its own bar: on iOS 27 the zoom left the bar faded out (alpha 0, not hidden) after every let-go dismissal, its title, Back and ⋯ gone until reopened (Eric, 2026-11-06, #1892: a group chat lost its top menus after some scrolling; Bot Chats shared it; on simulators every let-go swipe on iOS 27.2, none on 26.5). The bar comes back, faded or hidden, once the swipe's transition settles with the chat still on top.

**Open gaps**
- A bot made on another device shows its pill words only once Bots Home is opened again or reconnects.
- Bots Home redraws on each AppState change, unlike the Sessions list (`V2ShownUpdates`); a roster is small, but a cold launch with many bots hasn't been measured.
- Dropping a bot on an existing room to add it isn't possible: hosted groups can't add members after they start (groups.* has no add), so the flight into a room is only for the room being started.
- On a phone, Hermes' new room opens over Bots Home as it's made, so its slide into its place plays out of sight; beside the list on a split window it shows.
- Not yet tried on a device: the faces' flight and the new room's slide (#1830); the bar's name field, Return on a keyboard, and a create that fails and is retried (#1863).
- Not yet tried on a device: a room's zoom from its portrait and back, and its swipes (#1864).
- Not yet tried on a device: the bar coming back after a let-go swipe (#1892; on an iOS 27.2 simulator it came back in 40 of 40 let-go swipes, from 0 of 40, snapping back with no fade a few ms after the zoom settles; the phone runs 27.3). The zoom's swipe down starting where a vertical drag between bubbles lands, rather than the transcript scrolling, is iOS's and stays.
- Not yet tried on a device: a room's long-press menu (#1865), and whether a room's lift and menu share the hold as a bot's do. Its drag was (build 254, so #1871 changed where a drop lands and the +); the slide while in hand and its feel, for rooms and bots, are not yet: #1883's 0.3 s wait, the bots' 12 pt still hold, and the merge reaching 14 pt beside the face and above it up to the cell's top (#1886). Whether a drop's location comes in the cell's space, as documented, or the window's, which #1886 also reads, is unknown until a face grows on a phone. If it's the window's, a drag that goes straight into the top of the first-row face near the window's corner may still read as a slide until some hover has shown the window's space (#1886's reviews); any drag that crosses another cell settles it for the rest of the run.
- A room dragged onto the room being started, or a bot onto a room, does nothing and says nothing.
- A picture chosen, made or removed from a room's tile that fails says so only in the chat's error, which Bots Home doesn't show (#1865).
- A portrait or a room's tile dragged out of Conduit (an iPad split, Stage Manager) carries its marked name or room id as plain text, which another app's text field accepts; a private drag type would need one declared in the app's Info.plist. Text dragged in from another app within 3 s of a cancelled drag (whose item the system had let go of) counts as that bot or room while it hovers, so a 0.3 s hold over another face or tile slides the old one; its drop reads its own text, so unmarked text does nothing (text carrying a portrait's or tile's mark moves that one, as it always has). A private drag type would close this too. A drag whose item went early and is then held perfectly still over a face for over 3 s stops counting as in hand: the + comes back and no slide or room starts for the rest of that drag; its drop still lands by its own text (#1883).
- The bots' order is by profile name, so a renamed profile goes to the end; Hermes Desktop keeps no order of its own to match.
- The thread with a spark there and back between two portraits that hand work off isn't drawn: each portrait shows its side. Nor does the waiting badge open the other bot, being inside the portrait's button.
- The other bot is found by the name it had when it asked, so after a rename its color and face don't show (the words still do).
- The Bot Overview's header has no finish: its ripple and check play on Bots Home's portrait only.
- A speaking bot's glint isn't drawn: Hermes' room status says the room works, not which member speaks, so the pill names the room instead. A room past the 8 talked in last, or a Desktop group chat, never shows as live.
- A Bot Chat's swipe home from anywhere (and a workstream's to its Bot Chat) also fires over a code block or table scrolled sideways, where the system's own swipe would scroll it back first. It starts only in the chat's column, not a panel beside it, and waits while someone types in the composer.
- A bot dragged across the pinned ones' edge, on the grid or in Reorder Bots, goes back to its group with no word why; Reorder Bots has no section for the pinned bots.
- A workstream opened from the overview whose open fails leaves the zoom armed until it goes stale (3 s), since its link says nothing when it fails: a chat a notification or link pushes in Bots in that time would grow out of that bot's portrait.
- A workstream opened before its bot's work list was read isn't known as that bot's, so while it shows the zoom lets go, and Back from the Bot Chat after it is a plain pop until the next open from the portrait. Opened from the Bot Chat (its panel, cards and links come from that list), it's known.
- Bots Home's voice menu calls a working bot like any other: with Classic voice, whose call waits for a running reply, its chat opens and voice says to stop the reply first.
- Not yet tried on a device: the portraits' motion and what many working bots cost (one 30 fps timeline each while they move); the scroll view's long press, drag and drop on each portrait (#1714); whether a drag's lift and the portrait's long-press menu share the hold (a long press crashed on build 248: the drag's preview is drawn without the app's state, which is now handed to it), the merge dwell's feel, and whether a cancelled drag lets go of its item at once (a portrait or tile counts as in hand while its item lives, or for 3 s after a drop target last saw it, so the hover shows a move and not a +; a drop reads the bot or room from its own text unless the item still lives, so a foreign drop in those 3 s never borrows it).

**Checked:** 2026-11-06, #1892 (a chat grown from its portrait, a room or a Bot Chat, gets its bar back after a swipe back let go, the zoom on iOS 27 having left it faded out; chats pushed from Sessions share the keeper; the Watch, CarPlay and the drawer shell have no zoom); 2026-11-06, #1887 (#1886's reviews: the Checked line and the gap say how far above the face a hold reaches and until when the first-row corner can still be misread; no behavior changed); 2026-11-06, #1886 (Eric's TestFlight after #1883: holding a bot over a face never started a room, and the face never grew even held right over it; a drop's location is now read in the cell's space even if it comes in the window's (BotDragPayload.cellPoint; once one point shows the window's space, every later one is read that way, so a first-row face near the window's corner isn't misread after any drag has crossed another cell), since that's what a face that never grows suggests; a hold over the face or within 14 pt beside it (above it, only to the cell's top) now merges, so a bot slowing on its way in no longer slides the face away first); 2026-11-06, #1885 (review follow-up: the merge-zone test checks a point only the larger middle holds; ## Bots: create and edit

New Bot and Edit Bot, and what they write to the bot's Hermes profile.
Hermes Desktop's bot editor writes the same records, so both apps show the
same bot.

**Siblings:** New Bot · Edit Bot, from the Bots list, a Bot Chat's ⋯ menu (#1677) and the Bot Overview (#1678) · Hermes Desktop's bot editor (same
profile records) · the bot's face in the Bots list (a portrait on Bots Home, with the row's menu on a long press; see Bots Home), its Bot Chat and group
rooms · generated pictures, shared with group pictures · pictures from Apple's Image Playground (see Pictures from Image Playground) · profile pictures in the profile picker · the profile's name everywhere else in Conduit (Profile names) · a GIF or short video as the picture, or a still brought to life (see Moving pictures) · the SOUL a new bot is
born with (the messaging section older gateways need) · the Bots list's row
menu (New Chat, Groups, Pin, Hide, Duplicate, Delete) and its Hidden section,
as on Desktop's bot row · Edit Bot's MCP catalog (adding a server with
its keys, OAuth sign-in through Safari, and the sign-in loopback shared with
Hermes sign-in) · what the editor shows before Hermes answers (Screens that
open on their last answer) · Edit Bot > Work, the bot's workstream settings,
kept by the plugin (see Bot workstreams; done) · the text that describes them (the editor's footers
and README.md's bots line)

**Code**
- Editor: `Conduit/Views/BotEditorSheet.swift` (also opened from a Bot Chat's ⋯ menu, `V2ConversationMenu` in `Conduit/Views/V2/V2ConversationScreen.swift`), `Conduit/Views/BotModelPicker.swift`, `Conduit/Views/BotCapabilitiesView.swift`, `Conduit/Views/BotRosterView.swift`, `Conduit/Views/BotWorkSettingsView.swift` (Edit Bot > Work, see Bot workstreams)
- Writes: `Conduit/Services/BotManagement.swift` (BotCreateRequest, BotCapabilities, BotSoul, BotMetaPatch), `Conduit/Services/AppState.swift` (createBot, updateBot, saveBotModel, loadBotDetails, loadBotCapabilities, openNewBotChat; what a save, an MCP add or a sign-in Hermes took is kept for the editor, see Screens that open on their last answer), `Conduit/Services/HermesClient.swift` (createBotProfile, describeBotProfile, configureBotProfile, configureBotModel, botRuntimeCheck)
- Roster: `Conduit/Services/BotModeModels.swift`
- MCP catalog and sign-in: `Conduit/Views/BotCapabilitiesView.swift` (catalogRow, signInRow, BotMcpKeysSheet, BotMcpBrowserView), `Conduit/Services/BotMcpSetup.swift`, `Conduit/Services/AppState.swift` (loadBotMcpSetup, addBotMcpServer, signInBotMcpServer), `Conduit/Services/HermesClient.swift` (botMcpCatalog, botMcpServers, addBotMcpServer, setBotMcpKey, testBotMcpServer, botMcpOAuth), `Conduit/Services/NativeOAuth.swift` (NativeOAuthLoopbackServer's relay mode, NativeOAuthFlow.callbackValues), `Conduit/Services/NativeMCPSignIn.swift` (the flow, shared with the Connectors page)
- Row menu: `Conduit/Views/BotRosterView.swift` (BotRosterRow, BotRosterMenu, which Bots Home's portraits share, botRooms, the Hidden section), `Conduit/Services/BotManagement.swift` (BotDuplicate), `Conduit/Services/AppState.swift` (duplicateBot, setBotHidden, setBotPinned, canDeleteBot, deleteBot and forgetKeptBot), `Conduit/Views/GroupChatView.swift` (GroupCreateSheet's preselected bots)
- A bot's face and color in its Bot Chat: `Conduit/Services/AppState.swift` (conversationAgentIdentity), `Conduit/Services/AppState+V2Shell.swift` (profileGlowTint), both from the shown roster
- Generated pictures: `Conduit/Views/GeneratePictureSheet.swift`, `Conduit/Services/PictureGeneration.swift`, `Conduit/Services/GroupRoomPictures.swift` (group pictures' list and upload, and the ones kept for the Bots list), `Conduit/Views/GroupChatView.swift` (GroupRoomPicturePicker, GroupRoomActionItems), `Conduit/Views/V2/V2ConversationScreen.swift` (the V2 room menu's picker), `Conduit/Services/AppState.swift` (refreshPictureGeneration, generatePicture), `Conduit/Services/HermesClient.swift` (imageGenerationAvailable, generateImage)

**Rulings**
- A bot's look lives on Hermes: title, color and picture kind in `ui_meta['hermes-bots']`, the picture in the profile's asset store, never on the device (2026-10-02, #297; 2026-10-14, #580).
- New Bot does what Desktop's does: it copies the main profile's settings and shares its keys and accounts unless Advanced says otherwise (Start From another bot or a fresh profile, a separate copy of the keys, no bundled skills), then introduces itself only when its profile can reach a model (2026-10-23, Eric asked for Desktop parity).
- An edited bot always keeps a model of its own: Edit Bot offers no "Same as Main Profile", since `profiles.configure` pins a provider and model and has no way to clear the pin (2026-10-23).
- On Edit Bot, a model pick the gateway guards (expensive or data-training) is saved only after the user confirms its message (2026-10-23).
- Skills, tools and MCP write only the sections the user changed; a new bot's lists start from its Start From profile, as on Desktop. A fresh profile offers no lists until it exists, since its set is Hermes' defaults (Desktop shows the main profile's instead) (2026-10-24, #1177).
- A bot keeps at least one tool on: `enabled_toolsets: []` means Hermes' default tools, so turning every tool off can't be saved (2026-10-24, #1177).
- MCP servers are plain on/off per server: `enabled_mcp_servers: []` turns them all off (2026-10-24, #1177).
- Edit Bot adds servers from Hermes' catalog (`mcp.catalog`) the way Desktop's Set Up does: `mcp.servers.add` from the preset, each typed key through `mcp.servers.set_api_key` (blank ones skipped), then `mcp.servers.test`. The Connectors page sets the same keys through the dashboard's `/api/env`, which lands in the same `.env` variable (#1640). Hermes writes the server at once, so it stays even if the editor is cancelled, as on Desktop. Keys go to Hermes and aren't kept on the phone (2026-10-24).
- An OAuth server (from `mcp.servers.list`, or the add reply) signs in in Safari. Hermes runs the flow and keeps the tokens; the redirect comes back to a loopback on the phone, which hands it to Hermes (`client_redirect_uri` and `mcp.servers.oauth.callback`, as Desktop does for a remote Hermes). A Hermes that ignores the redirect is told to update rather than opening a page that can't finish (2026-10-24). The Connectors page runs the same flow (NativeMCPSignIn); a start Hermes answered after the editor gave up is still cancelled on Hermes (#1640).
- New Bot offers no catalog: the server and its keys live in the bot's profile, which doesn't exist until Create. Desktop creates the profile early instead; Conduit says to add them in Edit Bot (2026-10-24).
- Generated pictures come from Hermes' own image generation (`image.generate`) or Apple's Image Playground. Hermes' generator shows only when Hermes says a backend is set up, and the bot editor and group pictures share its sheet (2026-10-24, #1179); Image Playground follows its own availability, and Generate becomes a menu of both when both can (2026-11-05, #1813, see Pictures from Image Playground). Every way to set the picture (Choose Photo, Choose GIF or Video, Generate, Bring to Life, Remove or Keep Photo) is an item in one Edit Picture menu under the face, Generate a submenu when both generators can: as a row of buttons they wrapped letter by letter on a phone (Eric, 2026-11-06, #1862).
- A group picture read or change that a dashboard or room switch overtook commits nothing and says nothing, on success and failure alike (#862 follow-up, #1191).
- Duplicate makes `<name>-2` (the first free number) as a full `clone_from` copy, then copies the look with " (copy)" on the title, as Desktop's `duplicateBot` does. A clone doesn't copy the asset store, so Conduit copies the photo itself and only claims one that landed; the copy is neither hidden nor pinned, whatever the original is (2026-10-24, #1192).
- Hide is the ui_meta `hidden` flag Desktop writes: a hidden bot moves to a collapsed Hidden section at the end of the list, and Desktop hides it too. It keeps working and keeps its rooms, but isn't offered for a new group, whose picker lists visible bots only (2026-10-24, #1192).
- Groups lists the hosted rooms the bot is in, then New Group Chat with the bot already picked. Hosted groups can't add or remove members after they start, so there's no Add to Group (2026-10-24).
- A kept bot, drawn from Hermes' last answer until it answers again (Screens that open on their last answer), is never written: its copy has no ui_meta to send back whole, so its row offers only New Chat and Groups' rooms, and updateBot, setBotPinned, setBotHidden, duplicateBot and deleteBot (canDeleteBot) refuse one. A bot's face shows from the copy of its picture the profile pictures keep on the phone until the fetch lands, and a kept bot's Bot Chat shows its face and color from the kept roster. A deleted bot leaves the kept roster as it goes, on the dashboard it was deleted from even if its bridge was rebuilt meanwhile, so neither a read after the delete that fails nor one asked before it brings it back (2026-10-31, #1568).
- The SOUL is one row on the editor, its first three lines, and opens on a page of its own to edit: inline, a long one pushed Work and Advanced out of sight (Eric 2026-11-05, #1787).
- Edit Bot opens on the bot's SOUL, model, skills, tools and MCP servers as Hermes gave them last time, New Bot on its Start From profile's lists and the MCP page on the catalog and sign-ins, all read-only until Hermes answers, since a save compares with Hermes' own; what a save, a catalog add or a sign-in Hermes took is what they open on next (Screens that open on their last answer, 2026-10-31, #1588).

**Open gaps**
- New Bot's model pick isn't guarded: `profiles.create` pins it without the gateway's expensive-model check, the same as on Desktop.
- Desktop's drawn faces, shapes and pets show only as stills; Conduit draws an initial on the color.
- The group picture switch guard has no test: it needs a ready DashboardTicketBridge double and a room switch mid-request (#1191).
